records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During both the 2023 second quarter and first six months, approximately 55% of KMT inland revenues were under term contracts and 45% were spot contract revenues.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consequently, KMT is directly affected by the volumes produced by the Company’s petroleum, petrochemical, and refining customer base.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The net result was an increase of eight inland tank barges and approximately 0.2 million barrels of capacity during the 2023 first six months.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increases for the 2023 second quarter and first six months were primarily due to higher term and spot pricing and increased tank barge utilization in the inland and coastal markets.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities for the 2023 first six months increased in comparison to the 2022 first six months primarily due to higher business activity levels and the receipt of the IRS refund.
